verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in, AI-driven browser agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, BrowserUse) that take a task through a single API call and execute it live in managed cloud sessions. HyperAgent's page.ai() also accepts natural-language task delegation. This is delegation to agents through an API and SDK rather than a conversational assistant built into the product interface, and it is supported only by vendor docs. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant interface (chat or dashboard UI), evidence of multi-step task management or handoff beyond single browser tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agent tasks work as claimed.
